Class OAuthAuthorization

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.entities.BaseID<Integer>
grafiosch.entities.UserBaseID
grafiosch.entities.OAuthAuthorization
@Entity public class OAuthAuthorization extends UserBaseID
The token family of one OAuth consent: a user allowed one client, identified by the URL of its metadata document, to act on one resource with one scope. The access and refresh tokens issued under it are rows of UserAccessToken that reference this family and disappear with it.

A family ends at expiresAt, at the latest 90 days after the consent, however often its tokens are refreshed; no token outlives it. Revoking it in the token dialog deletes it together with its tokens. A replayed refresh token marks it as revoked, which every token of the family then fails on.

Never exported: its tokens are hashes that are worthless on another instance, and a client has to obtain a new consent there anyway. The account deletion removes it.
